⭐ One of the Best Restaurants in Phu Quoc!
May 2026 • Family
One of the best dining experiences we had in Phu Quoc! We visited Cơm Gia Đình 껌자딘 during our stay in Sunset Town, and it quickly became one of our favorite restaurants on the island.

The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and prepared with authentic Vietnamese home-style cooking. Every dish we ordered was well-seasoned and beautifully presented. The menu offers a great variety of local favorites, making it easy for everyone in the group to find something they enjoy.

What stood out even more was the warm and friendly service. The staff were attentive, welcoming, and happy to help with recommendations. The restaurant itself was clean, comfortable, and air-conditioned, which was perfect after a day of exploring Phu Quoc.

If you're looking for authentic Vietnamese food, generous portions, reasonable prices, and a family-friendly atmosphere, this place is a must-visit. We will definitely return the next time we're in Phu Quoc!

Highly recommended!
